invariants.rationale: FileHandle parameters (tmxFile) are generally expected to be non-null for correct operation.
The tileSet is used for property lookup and tile addition; being null would cause method failures.
tileElements is iterated over (for loop), so expected to be non-null.
tilewidth is used as a divisor; it must be positive to avoid division by zero and indicate valid tile dimensions.
tileheight is also used as a divisor for calculations such as number of tiles in the set, so must be positive.
